name: Shiranui Nanami
source:
A young girl with a fragile, doll-like appearance, she is actually incredibly capable as she was born into a ninja clan, dating back to very old times. Her physical abilities are exceedingly high, and she's good at erasing her presence. 
She rarely expresses her feelings, making it difficult to read her emotions. She thinks much differently than those around her while at the same time able to find common ground.

She has the ability to erase the memories of others, and has been ordered by her father to use that ability many times. She fears her powers and hates having them with all of her heart.

The routes of Ron, Heishi, and Akito are only accessible when the player selects Nanami as the protagonist.

[From [url=http://aksysgames.com/norn9/characters/]English official site[/url]]
